Commodity bucket: Energy – non EU ETS carbon trading
Examples of commodities allocated to eac:
* Light-sweet crude oil; heavy crude oil; West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude; Brent crude; etc (ie various types of crude oil)
* Bioethanol; biodiesel ; etc (ie various biofuels)
* Suezmax; Aframax; very large crude carriers (ie various liquid-bulk/gas shipping route)Propane; ethane; gasoline; methanol; butane; etc (ie various petrochemicals)
* Jet fuel; kerosene; gasoil; fuel oil; naphtha; heating oil; diesel etc (ie various refined fuels)
* Spot electricity; day-ahead electricity; peak electricity; off-peak electricity (ie various electricity types)renewable energy certificates; etc (ie various carbon trading emissions)
* Certified emissions reductions; in-delivery month EU allowance; Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative CO2 allowance;
* Certified emissions reductions; in-delivery month EU allowance; Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative CO2 allowance;

* Capesize; Panamax; Handysize; Supramax (ie various types of dry-bulk route)
* Suezmax; Aframax; very large crude carriers (ie various liquid-bulk/gas shipping route)

* Aluminium; copper; lead; nickel; tin; zinc (ie various base metals)
* Steel billet ; steel wire; steel coil ; steel scrap; steel rebar; iron ore; tungsten; vanadium; titanium; tantalum (ie steel raw materials)
* Cobalt; manganese; molybdenum (ie various minor metals)

* Corn; wheat; soybean seed; soybean oil; soybean meal; oats; palm oil; canola; barley; rapeseed seed; rapeseed oil; rapeseed meal; red bean; sorghum; coconut oil; olive oil; peanut oil; sunflower oil; rice
* Live cattle; feeder cattle; hog; poultry; lamb; fish; shrimp; milk; whey; eggs; butter; cheese
* Cocoa; arabica coffee; robusta coffee; tea; citrus juice; orange juice; potatoes; sugar; cotton; wool; lumber; pulp; rubber

* Potash; fertilizer; phosphate rocks (ie various industrial materials)
* Rare earths; terephthalic acid; flat glass

Description: Other exotic underlyings which are not in the scope of the delta, vega or curvature risk
Options where the pay-offs depend on the path followed by the price of the underlying asset and not just its final price on the exercise date
Options that start at a predefined date in the future and whose strike price is not yet determined at the time at which the option is in the trading book of the institution
Options whose underlying is another option
Options allowing the holder to modify the strike price or other terms of the contract before the maturity of the option
Options that can be exercised on a finite set of predetermined dates
Options whose underlying is denominated in one currency but whose pay-offs are settled in a different currency, with a predetermined exchange rate between the two currencies
Options that do not have a maturity
Options that do not have a strike or barrier and options that have multiple strikes or barriers
Other instruments exposed to residual risk
